_notes: hp is a multiplier on the wave's base health (see waves.json); speed is world units per second. Traits: flying, regen (fraction of max health per second, halted by poison), heal [fraction, every N seconds, radius] (a creep can only be mended once every 1.8s, so healers do not stack), split [child creep, count], slow_resist (0..1), boss (resists slows, immune to freeze and stun). lives is how many lives a leak costs.

gloomling.name: Gloomling
gloomling.description: Rift-spawned rabble. No strengths, no weaknesses.

bristleboar.name: Bristleboar
bristleboar.description: Fast and thin-skinned. Arrows punish it.

skitterling.name: Skitterling
skitterling.description: Comes in swarms. Splash and chain attacks clear them best.

marauder.name: Hollow Marauder
marauder.description: Plate and shield. Blast and arcane damage break it; arrows barely scratch it.

gloomwing.name: Gloomwing
gloomwing.description: Flies straight for the Heartfire, ignoring the road. Cannons and braziers cannot reach it.

mire_crawler.name: Mire Crawler
mire_crawler.description: Regenerates as it walks. Poison stops the healing; burst it down or it recovers.

shellback.name: Shellback
shellback.description: Slow and thickly armored. Venom strips the shell; cannons and prisms crack it.

hexer.name: Bog Hexer
hexer.description: Warded against arcane and mends nearby creeps. Kill it first; fire and frost cut through wards.

ooze.name: Mire Ooze
ooze.description: Bursts into two oozelings when it dies. Keep some damage in reserve further down the road.

oozeling.name: Oozeling
oozeling.description: What is left of an ooze. Quick, but fragile.

houndrider.name: Dreadhound Rider
houndrider.description: Armored and fast. Slow it with frost or it will be past your towers before they reload.

wraith.name: Pale Wraith
wraith.description: Half here, half elsewhere: arrows and shells pass through, slows barely hold. Arcane and fire burn it away.

stalker.name: Night Stalker
stalker.description: The fastest thing out of the rift. Frost and long range are your friends.

ogre.name: Stone Ogre
ogre.description: A walking boulder. A leak costs two lives. Prisms and cannons, and venom to soften the hide.

drake.name: Carrion Drake
drake.description: A flying brute. Ballistas deal double damage to flyers; storm coils and prisms help.

ogre_warlord.name: Ogre Warlord
ogre_warlord.description: BOSS. Shrugs off half of every slow and cannot be frozen. Focus it with prisms and ballistas.

behemoth.name: Gorehide Behemoth
behemoth.description: BOSS. A mountain of plated hide that slowly knits itself back together. Strip its armor with venom.

elder_drake.name: Elder Drake
elder_drake.description: BOSS, FLYING. Only towers that can hit air will touch it. Ballistas are worth double here.

hollow_king.name: The Hollow King
hollow_king.description: FINAL BOSS. Warded, heavily armored, mends his guard, and ends the game if he reaches the Heartfire.
